note: Unattended multi-section run override: working set = ALL sections.music.core (3) + the ENTIRE 24-entry sections.music.keywords list (27 seeds total), no rotating subset. No WebSearch was used at plan time; the plan is built from keyword_pool.json + sources.json + the music history in news_data.json. Rotation is applied to EMPHASIS/query order instead, by date 2026-08-11 (day-of-year 223; 223 mod 24 = 7, 223 mod 6 = 1). Freshness window for this section is 14 days (336h), so queries deliberately reach back past the 72h default. Emphasis history: 08-08 fronted the voice/performance/visual layer plus the model layer; 08-09 fronted studio craft and composition and it PAID OFF (I Am Choir, MIXVAULT, a Suno songwriting op-ed, MIDiA on the missing AI hit); 08-10 fronted the performance/playback/instrument cluster but the brief that actually shipped was RIGHTS-AND-PLATFORM heavy (Spotify x Merlin AI covers, Suno Vinyl, the KOMCA reversal, the label chart-eligibility rules, the CDM anti-AI 'poison music' genre). So the saturated zone today is streaming-platform policy, charts, collecting-society rules, litigation and data poisoning — all pushed to LOW. 08-11 rotates BACK to the maker layer that has not shipped a card since 08-09 and fronts: mastering, mixing, plugins and DAW-embedded AI (Ableton / Logic Pro), stem separation, sample and one-shot generation, neural synthesis instruments and AI-assisted hardware, songwriting assistants, consented voice models, plus the model/platform layer that keeps missing (Stable Audio, Riffusion, Udio, ElevenLabs Music, Lyria/MusicFX). Suno as a company stays LOW because it has carried two of the last three days. sources.json defines no instagram_handles for the music category, so IG is skipped. Social channel rotation: 08-09 used Venus Theory / Benn Jordan / Udio, 08-10 used Suno / ElevenLabs / Andrew Huang, so 08-11 advances the wheel to index 223 mod 6 = 1 and takes Udio / Benn Jordan / Venus Theory.
